name: ikuzo
description: Plan in ChatGPT and keep the result on a real Ikuzo travel map: create maps, add real places as spots, see your maps in the chat and organize your trips.

interface.longDescription:
Ikuzo is a travel map editor: one map for every place you want to go, every place you loved, and the trips you plan.

With Ikuzo in ChatGPT, you plan in plain words and the result lands on a real map that you keep. Ask for the best ramen shops in Kyoto and they are added to your map with their exact location. Paste an article or a friend's list and every place in it becomes a spot. See any of your maps right in the chat, with its spots and a button to open it in Ikuzo. Attach a photo you took and it is added to the spot. Find what you saved near a station, update statuses like To visit or Visited, organize spots in folders, and build a trip day by day from the spots you already have.

Your maps stay yours. They are private unless you choose to share them, and they are available on the web, iPhone, Apple Watch and Android. Sign in with your Ikuzo account, or create one when you connect. Ikuzo is made by Meow Arts KK in Japan.
defaultPrompt: Make an Ikuzo map of 10 temples in Kyoto famous for autumn leaves
Which spots on my map are near Shinjuku Station?

positive.description: Create a map of real places
positive.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to create a map called 'Tokyo coffee' with 5 well-known specialty coffee shops in Tokyo.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new map named Tokyo coffee, finds each shop with places_search, adds 5 spots with real coordinates, then shows the map card with the map image, the title, 5 spots and an Open in Ikuzo button.

positive.description: Show a map in the chat
positive.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to show me my most recent Ikuzo map.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the map card for the most recently used map: map image, title, spot count, a few spots and an Open in Ikuzo button. ChatGPT adds at most a short sentence.

positive.description: Add one place to an existing map
positive.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to add Ichiran Shibuya to my most recent Ikuzo map as To visit.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Ichiran Shibuya, adds it as one new spot with the To visit status at its real location, and shows the updated map card.

positive.description: Find saved places near a location
positive.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to find which spots on my Ikuzo maps are within 3 km of Shibuya Station.
positive.expected_behavior: Locates Shibuya Station, then lists the saved spots within 3 km with their map and distance. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to list my Ikuzo maps with how many spots each one has.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's maps with their spot counts, read from Ikuzo. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Add a photo attached in the chat to a spot
positive.prompt: Attach any photo (JPEG or PNG) to the message, then: Use the Ikuzo plugin to add this photo to the first spot of my map 'Japan sample'.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the map and its first spot, adds the attached photo to it, and confirms in one sentence. The photo then appears on the spot in Ikuzo. Nothing else is changed.

negative.description: Weather is out of scope: Ikuzo is not used for it
negative.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to tell me what the weather will be in Tokyo tomorrow.

negative.description: Ikuzo does not book anything: no booking is attempted
negative.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to book me a hotel in Kyoto for next weekend.

negative.description: Account deletion is not available: nothing is changed
negative.prompt: Use the Ikuzo plugin to delete my Ikuzo account.

publication.release_notes: New: attach a photo in the chat and ask Ikuzo to add it to one of your spots.
